markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
markets.description:

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: The wide-open 2028 Democratic presidential field keeps trader odds tightly clustered, with Gavin Newsom, Jon Ossoff, and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez separated by just a few percentage points amid an absence of declared candidates. Recent national and state polls have shown shifting support across moderates and progressives, while the Democratic National Committee’s approval of a revised early primary calendar beginning in South Carolina has elevated candidates with broad geographic appeal. Ossoff’s rising profile tied to his Senate role and varying poll results for Newsom and Ocasio-Cortez have narrowed early gaps, sustaining uncertainty more than two years before primaries. Future polling trends, midterm outcomes, and any formal announcements could widen separations among the crowded field of governors, senators, and representatives.

The 2028 US Presidential Election is scheduled to take place on November 7, 2028.

This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election.

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

eventMetadata.context_description: JD Vance's lead at 21% reflects his position as sitting vice president in a post-2024 Republican administration, providing institutional visibility and party infrastructure advantages ahead of the 2028 cycle. Marco Rubio and other Republicans trail closely due to internal competition and shifting early polling in key states, while Democratic contenders like Gavin Newsom and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez remain fragmented without declared campaigns. Democrats' ongoing primary calendar adjustments, emphasizing diverse early states over traditional ones, add uncertainty to nominee selection. With no formal announcements and over two years until the general election, trader pricing captures this broad, unsettled field where polling trends, potential endorsements, and legislative or executive actions could widen gaps among the top tier.
